records.summary_en: - In Ecuador’s Intag Valley, 19 families are developing a 300-kilowatt hydropower project that can provide an alternative source of income to the large-scale extractive and productive industries that are common in the Imbabura province. - The communities own 90% of the HidroAguagrún project and half of its net electricity revenue will go directly into a trust for conservation activities once the plant is fully operational. - The project offers a potential model for community-owned renewable energy, but replicability depends on community willingness and cohesion, water availability and funding.

records.title_en: Global battery storage additions reached 108 GW in 2025
records.summary_zh: 国际能源署统计显示，2025年全球新增电池储能装机同比增长40%，磷酸铁锂约占部署量的90%，储能成为增长最快的电力技术。
records.summary_en: IEA data show that global battery storage additions rose 40% in 2025 to 108 GW. Lithium iron phosphate supplied about 90% of deployments, making storage the fastest-growing power technology.

records.title_zh: 美国上一季度建设的电网电池储能创下历史新高
records.title_en: The US built more grid batteries last quarter than ever before
records.summary_zh: 根据美国太阳能工业协会和基准矿物情报机构发布的报告，今年第二季度美国电力部门新增的电池储能容量达到历史最高水平。受锂离子电池成本暴跌和技术普及推动，4月至6月期间建造了20.2吉瓦时的电池容量，占全国电网总储能容量的十分之一，多地开发商和人工智能数据中心正广泛采用电池来应对用电高峰。
records.summary_en: There’s never been a better time to build energy storage in the U.S. than right now. Grid batteries — which sop up power when it’s abundant and discharge that energy when it’s needed — have been ascendant for a decade, as the price of the underlying lithium-ion cells fell precipitously . records.title_zh: 美国东海岸最大数据中心之一被指控“违反联邦法律”
records.title_en: One of east coast’s largest datacenters accused of ‘violating federal law’
records.summary_zh: 热红外无人机画面显示，由微软支持、位于新泽西州文兰的 DataOne 人工智能数据中心在未获得许可证的情况下运行数十台燃气发电机。前美国环保署官员指出此举违反联邦法律并排放有害空气污染物，而新泽西州环境保护局确认未向该设施颁发任何发电机许可证。
records.summary_en: Thermal drone footage shows a Microsoft-backed AI datacenter powering its operations with dozens of unpermitted generators The largest planned AI datacenter in New Jersey is being accused of violating federal law after a visual investigation found the site running dozens of unpermitted gas-powered generators. Thermal drone footage captured by the non-profit newsroom Floodlight last week showed the partly completed DataOne facility in Vineland was operating at least 45 of the site’s 62 generators at the time. records.title_zh: 2025年全球数据中心用电量增长17%
records.title_en: Global data-centre electricity use rose 17% in 2025
records.summary_zh: 国际能源署指出，人工智能专用数据中心用电量在2025年增长50%；电网接入、供电可靠性、能效和储能配置成为数据中心扩张的关键约束。
records.summary_en: The IEA reports that electricity use by AI-focused data centres rose 50% in 2025. Grid connections, reliable supply, efficiency and storage are becoming critical constraints on expansion.

records.title_zh: 国际能源署发布《能源与人工智能》报告
records.title_en: IEA publishes Energy and AI
records.summary_zh: 报告建立全球和区域数据中心电力需求模型，分析人工智能对能源安全、排放、创新和可负担性的影响，并讨论供电、能源与电网配置。
records.summary_en: The report models global and regional data-centre electricity demand and assesses implications for energy security, emissions, innovation and affordability, including options for power supply and grids.
